name: Newport Aquarium

facts.text: Elevators connect the lobby to exhibits. Restrooms have accessible stalls; family and companion restrooms are near the main elevator and Sharky's Cafe.
Free manual wheelchairs are first come, first served at Guest Services; a photo ID is held as a deposit.
Free sensory bags with headphones, fidgets and cue cards can be borrowed with ID, subject to availability. Louder areas have headphone-zone signs.
The accessibility page links advance-visit social stories and visual guides.
Shark Bridge has a mobility restriction; a periscope offers an alternative tank view. Ask staff about Tide Pool accommodations.

limitations: Public website reporting; no on-site audit. Individual exhibits and encounters have restrictions; consult the linked guide before booking.

name: The Carnegie

facts.text: The venue lists adjacent accessible parking, elevators between building levels and a ramp to the Eva G. Farris Education Center.
The Otto M. Budig Theatre mezzanine cannot be reached by ramp or elevator.
Captioning and ASL interpretation are offered at selected performances; contact the box office for dates and availability.

limitations: Public website reporting; no on-site audit. Performance accommodations depend on the event; mezzanine seating has a stated barrier.

name: Creation Museum

facts.text: Entrances and exits have ramps; the first entrance has an automatic door. Main exhibits use gradual ramps, with an elevator back to the main level.
The museum identifies Dino Den as an exception to wheelchair exhibit access. Wheelchair and electric mobility rentals are first come, first served.
Complimentary sensory kits and hearing protection are available at the Welcome Center and Guest Services. The 4D theater includes flashing lights, loud audio, moving seats and air effects.
A photo social story and accessibility map help visitors prepare.
The museum lists vegetarian and gluten-free dining options and asks visitors to consult a restaurant manager about dietary needs.

limitations: Public website reporting; no on-site audit. Rental availability does not establish access to every attraction. Food options are not an allergen-free guarantee; consult staff.

name: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (CVG)

facts.text: Terminal entrances have curb ramps; elevators serve the garage, terminal and both concourses.
A family-assist restroom near Gate B13 has an adult changing table.
The airport lists a sensory space, ASL announcement translations and blind/low-vision navigation services.
Familiarization tours and step-by-step airport directions are available.
The Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program lets travelers discreetly indicate that they may need additional assistance.

limitations: Public website reporting; no on-site audit. Some facilities are beyond security. Arrange wheelchair assistance with the airline before travel.

name: Truist Arena

facts.text: Wheelchair seating is offered at all price levels, with up to three companion tickets when available. Request accessible seating when buying tickets.
Accessible parking is in Lot O and the Welcome Center Garage; spaces are limited and first come, first served.
Amplification devices are available for most events with at least one week's notice and photo ID. Sign-language interpretation requests require three weeks' notice and production approval.
Staff offer wheelchair assistance to and from seats, but venue wheelchairs cannot be borrowed as event seating.

limitations: Public website reporting; no on-site audit. Seating, drop-off arrangements and accommodations may vary by event.

name: BB Riverboats

facts.text: Boarding ramps and main decks are described as wheelchair accessible. Belle of Cincinnati has an elevator to its first three decks; the fourth requires stairs.
River Queen's main deck is described as accessible.
Smoking is prohibited inside cabins but permitted on designated outdoor decks.

limitations: Public website reporting; no on-site audit. Confirm the assigned vessel and deck before booking; access differs between boats.

name: MegaCorp Pavilion

facts.text: All entries and restroom stalls are described as accessible; an elevator is near the first-floor entrance.
Accessible parking is in the attached lower garage, with elevators to the main entry. ADA seating is sold through AXS.
The venue requests at least two weeks' notice for a sign-language interpreter; late requests are considered when possible.

limitations: Public website reporting; no on-site audit. Contact the venue in advance about the specific indoor or outdoor event layout.

name: Boone County Public Library — Main Library

facts.text: A wheelchair may be borrowed after signing a waiver at the front desk.
The library's locations page lists all branches as smoke-free.
A second-floor sensory room offers calming activities and equipment, for up to five people or one family, in 30-minute sessions. Ask staff to sign in.
A social narrative is linked to help prepare for the sensory room.

limitations: Public library website/blog reporting; no on-site audit. Equipment and room availability may vary. Branch-specific entrance and route measurements were not documented in the inspected sources.

name: Florence Family Aquatic Center

facts.text: The city describes an accessible zero-depth pool and a paved path around the outside of the facility.
The facility lists shelters, sun umbrellas and a bathhouse with family restrooms.

limitations: Public city website reporting; no on-site audit. Seasonal venue: the posted 2026 operating season ends Labor Day. Verify the next opening date. No claim is made about lift access to other pools or slides.

name: Big Bone Lick State Historic Site

facts.text: The Discovery Trail includes a half-mile paved loop beginning behind the visitor center; other trails vary in terrain and difficulty.
The National Park Service listing identifies an accessible restroom, without dimensions or a specific location.
The National Park Service lists benches, picnic shelters and drinking water among site amenities.

limitations: Public government website reporting; no on-site audit. Paving does not establish route slope or universal access. The state page lists the campground swimming pool as closed until further notice.

name: Northern Kentucky Convention Center

facts.text: The Madison Avenue entrance has a sidewalk ramp and push-button doors. A passenger elevator connects the two main levels.
The venue lists accessible public restrooms, wheelchair access to meeting/event rooms and accessible Learning Center seating.
Two wheelchairs may be signed out from Administrative Offices, first come, first served, with photo ID held until return. Riser ramps should be requested ahead of time.

limitations: Public venue website reporting; no on-site audit. Event layouts and equipment availability should be confirmed with the organizer.
